title: teucrium luteum subsp. turdetanum
intro: Teucrium luteum subsp. turdetanum, commonly known as Spanish Germander, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb, native to the Mediterranean region, used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and protecting against oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of Spanish Germander include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as modulating the immune system and exerting antimicrobial effects.
